text:
shout out to all the “glue guys”…airport-test guys…ppl who don’t really have anything exceptional to offer but a gentle disposition and being relatively pleasant to have around

u can actually make it pretty damn far in this world based on those qualities alone

like a “can-do” attitude, and when ur boss tells u to run thru a wall, u say yessir, put ur head down, and run right thru that motherfucker

only works bc you’ll meet a lot of people along the way with “sharp edges” or some quality that DQ’s them…usually being too smart, thinking they’re special, thinking they’re too good for some humiliating task which was purely ordered as a shit test

u failed kid…u thought u were done getting hazed…ur just getting started.

crazy amt of W’s end up going to ppl who understand SDSU…not the aztecs…sit down, shut up. for whatever reason people always want to help the guy who just does good work and never asks for shit, complains, or makes excuses. 

lunch pail, shovel, hard hat

applies for all ages really…so strap up 🪖
